description: This Java class manages configuration for Android log filters within an IDE environment, including persistence, creation, and retrieval of filter entries based on process ID or package name.

classes.name: AndroidConfiguredLogFilters
classes.description: Manages persistent configuration of log filters, including creation, retrieval, and storage of filter entries.

classes.name: AndroidConfiguredLogFilters.MyFilterEntry
classes.description: Represents a single log filter entry with properties like name, message pattern, level, tag pattern, process ID, and package name pattern.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the configuration object for persistence.

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Loads the configuration state from a persisted object.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the configuration for a given project.

methods.name: getFilterEntries
methods.description: Returns a list of current filter entries.

methods.name: findFilterEntryByName
methods.description: Finds a filter entry by its name.

methods.name: createFilterForProcess
methods.description: Creates a new filter entry for a specific process ID.

methods.name: getFilterForPackage
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a filter entry for a specific package name.

methods.name: setFilterEntries
methods.description: Sets the list of filter entries.

methods.name: getPatternCompileFlags
methods.description: Determines regex compile flags based on the pattern string.
